packages.title: Reconcile the development snapshot and restore the quality baseline
acceptance: A module-by-module implementation and coverage inventory is recorded.
Imported archive modules have focused positive, negative and failure-injection tests.
The full harness is reproducible and no stable gate is weakened.
Conductor metadata and issue configuration reflect actual implementation and blockers.

packages.title: Harden source health, retries, networking and capture failure semantics
acceptance: Source observations classify freshness, change, degradation and disappearance.
Retries are bounded, idempotent and evidence-preserving.
DNS/private-address controls cover connection-time resolution and TLS hostname verification.
Metrics and structured failure categories are tested.

packages.title: Implement hierarchical rights and resumable publication state
acceptance: Rights propagate from source to derived artifact and target-specific publication decision.
Apply the approved archive-default rights policy; explicit restrictions and conflicting rights block incompatible publication targets, with recorded evidence and contingencies.
GitHub, Hugging Face and Zenodo publication steps are resumable and idempotent.
Cross-platform identifiers and receipts reconcile without duplicate deposits.

packages.title: Operationalise catalogue-complete LINZ archival through sharded CI
acceptance: Every catalogue identity receives an explicit content-bound disposition.
Catalogue, details, services, planning, payload and federation stages are independently resumable.
Storage and egress budgets bound every batch.
Changeset state is periodically reconciled against a full export.

packages.title: Add feature-level differences and provenance impact queries
acceptance: Snapshot differences distinguish added, removed, attribute-changed, geometry-changed and schema-changed entities.
Exact and tolerance-aware geometry comparisons remain separately evidenced.
Why, where, how and rebuild-impact queries report their actual lineage granularity.
Projection reconciliation removes or labels stale records deterministically.

packages.title: Complete broader standards conformance and signed stable-candidate qualification
acceptance: Independently maintained validators cover every claimed publication profile.
Broader standards-complete producer/consumer conformance and cross-language golden fixtures validate canonical hashes and schemas.
The v0.4.0 public technical preview is mirrored to Hugging Face, DOI-preserved on Zenodo and anonymously downloaded with byte verification.
The exact stable candidate has a trusted signed conformance report, verified SBOMs and attestations, and candidate-specific preservation receipts.

packages.title: Execute a bounded real LINZ-council-facility vertical slice
acceptance: One real LINZ source, council GIS source, planning source and facility source are captured within explicit bounds.
Raw evidence, canonical data, GeoParquet, DuckDB, quality, rights and lineage are linked.
A clean environment reconstructs the result.
No public release occurs without target-specific review.

packages.title: Implement ecosystem adapters in related repositories
acceptance: fyi-cli and fyi-archive mappings classify exact, approximate, extension-only and unmapped fields.
Each related change has its own issue, branch, tests and commit/PR.
Dirty clones are never modified.
Cross-repository conformance fixtures pass.

packages.title: Implement accessibility and facility-location solver cores
acceptance: Accessibility and optimisation remain separate reusable packages/interfaces.
Set covering, maximal covering, p-median, p-center and capacity models pass published or independently calculated benchmarks.
Equity objectives and constraints are explicit and Pareto outputs reproducible.
Solver claims include feasibility and independent verification.

packages.title: Implement simulation, health methods and applied reference pilots
acceptance: Simulation and causal claims have explicit estimands, assumptions and validation evidence.
Ambulance, hospital and supermarket pilots use versioned public/reference data and transparent value judgements.
No pilot is represented as an operational clinical, legal or commercial decision system.
Methods and research objects are independently reproducible.
